name: Debrief
description: Shows what an agent finished in a workspace as D2 diagrams: before and after for changed behaviour, a flow for new code, and a guided walkthrough of the code and the design decisions behind it.

settings.title: Diagram colours
settings.description: Auto follows Orca's theme. Dark redraws the light diagrams with soft dark colours in the panel; the files are unchanged.

settings.title: Captures folder
settings.description: Where captures live, relative to the workspace root. Keep it out of Git.

settings.title: Who draws a capture
settings.description: A background run is a one-shot headless Claude: no MCP servers, read-only git, a cost cap, and it stops when done. An idle agent already knows the work but carries the drawing in its own conversation.
enumLabels: An idle Claude in the workspace, else a background run

settings.title: Claude command
settings.description: Run with the workspace as its folder; ~/.local/bin and Homebrew are on its PATH.

settings.title: GitHub CLI command
settings.description: Finds the open pull request for a workspace's branch, so a review can read its description and comments. Read-only; uses your own gh login.
